artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Tracked read script for DB-i-13: reads the two saved round-122 bodies from the private folder, reads fact_positions partitions through the GET-only InflectionSilverReader (120 reads: 117 GETs and LIST pages), writes the private extract and the repo record. Not deployed; no AWS write, vendor call, secret read or push. Plan mode makes no S3 call.

The DB-i-13 record: script, body and extract hashes, series and early-end counts, per-account counts and verdicts, verdict counts, basis words, reader reads. Counts, digests and words only; files_in_repo_private, served_values_changed, pushed and deployed all false. Its extract.path field carries the private folder name, which holds an 8-digit run; the amended checker blanks that field before the scan.

Two surprise rows appended as bytes, one fenced json block each: IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W313-S1 (BLOCKING, the checker's no-identifier limb on the extract path; ruled by the issuer amendment 7ba971b30d) and IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W313-S2 (INERT, the re-run reconciliation).
